name: 支援・自動化・仕分けの有効状態を示す機能管理一覧
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized settings list screenshot matching the supplied three-row feature-management reference. Keep the compact, wide 3.0:1 composition.

Show exactly three equal-height white rows inside a subtle light-gray rounded outer border, separated by thin pale-gray dividers. Each row has a pale-gray rounded-square icon tile on the left, a bold feature name with one muted description beneath it, and a right-aligned state word with a simple right chevron at the far edge.

Use the exact Japanese content and states from the mock, in this order:

1. 「作業を支援」 — description 「共有領域に合わせて設定します。」 — state 「有効」. Use a simple triangular pointer/play-style outline icon.

2. 「支援処理の自動化」 — description 「新しい課題の受付時に業務フローを実行します。」 — state 「有効」. Use a small sparkle/automation icon.

3. 「自動仕分けの支援」 — description 「関連する課題と担当の属性を推定します。」 — state 「無効」. Use a simple circular bidirectional/triage icon.

Use the Japanese mock for exact labels, wording, compact typography, and spacing. Use the original crop for the row structure, icon tile placement, state alignment, divider styling, and chevrons. No Beta badges, controls, switches, extra descriptions, or page header. Use Meiryo: bold feature names, regular supporting text 12/16. Crisp Japanese glyphs, restrained neutral styling, no extra whitespace.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at 2171x724 (3.00:1), matching the 648x216 Japanese mock and close to the 814x261 source crop. All three localized feature rows, descriptions, enabled/disabled states, icons, and chevrons are present. Exact typography and pixel-level icon spacing remain unverified.
